citations.quote: Does this NDC represent one of the Part D drugs selected for negotiation under the Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program?

citations.section: IRA policy 1, Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program: the Selected Drug flag in the Basic Drugs Formulary file
citations.quote: The newly added Selected Drug flag in the Basic Drugs Formulary file can be used to determine which dispensing fee in the Pharmacy Network file applies to the drug.

insulin.note: The cached files give insulin cost sharing per plan and tier, not which products are covered insulin. The CMS pages checked publish no covered insulin product list (drug-lists.json).

acip_vaccine.note: No cached file lists the ACIP-recommended adult vaccines by RxCUI.

manufacturer_discount.note: CMS lists the labeler codes under a discount program agreement and the NDC-9s eligible for the phase-in (drug-lists.json, C20 to C22). Neither says whether a drug that is not selected was approved under an NDA or BLA, so whether it is an applicable drug stays open.

selected_drug_list.note: The CMS selected-drug NDC list (C16) is pinned in drug-lists.json and checked against the formulary flag. The fact sheets (C17, C18) name the drugs only and are never matched to a drug.
